description: This file defines the 'Exists' class, an operator used within the OpenMRS logic framework to test the existence of certain criteria related to patient encounters. It implements the TransformOperator interface and provides a string representation of the operator.

classes.name: Exists
classes.description: Represents an operator that checks the existence of certain criteria within the OpenMRS logic framework. Implements TransformOperator and provides a string identifier 'EXISTS'.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string 'EXISTS', representing the operator in textual form.
